style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: HE crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY beat, talking ones too, at a flat sprint; grass, mound and horizon streak across frame behind HIM in EVERY beat; HE fills half the frame height; camera rides beside HIM low and level, whipping over on each change of direction, new shot size and one impulse per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a burly iridescent scarab beetle, ridged horn, six scraping legs, dusty, utterly serious
second_characters: ONE plump dung fly in a tie running ahead of him at lens all clip, never still; A SWARM of flies streaming after THE BALL with a loud buzz in every beat
props: ONE huge matte dung ball, half his height; ONE flat rock right of frame; ONE crumb-sized gold coin packed inside THE BALL; ONE white lace handkerchief under his wing case; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: THE BALL runs ahead of him or beside him in every beat, never parked; the coin is buried and unseen until 8.15; the handkerchief stays hidden until 8.95
environment: a sun-baked savanna floor, dry grass, a cracked termite mound, wide bright sky

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: weary chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 0.75-3.3 one breath; pause 3.3-4.0; 4.0-7.35 one breath; after 7.35 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: a loud swarm buzzing behind THE BALL all clip, THE BALL grinding on dry earth, a dry crack at 8.15, one thin coin ping at 9.4, cicadas

timeline.a: he shoulders THE BALL and drives it left to right along the whole frame, earth blasting from under his legs, THE SWARM boiling after THE BALL
he rams THE BALL right to left across the whole frame at a flat sprint, FLY running ahead at lens
THE BALL squirts ahead and he tears after it left to right edge to edge, then hooks it with his horn and whips it back right to left, THE SWARM ripping across the frame after it
THE BALL throws him and he skids right to left on his back after it, THE SWARM overshooting him
THE BALL bolts away down the flat and he sprints after it left to right across the whole frame, THE SWARM streaming with it, FLY slung along at lens
he overtakes THE BALL, hooks it on his horn and slings it right to left back across the frame, a wall of dust and flies trailing him
he heads THE BALL left to right straight at lens
he boots THE BALL right to left into the rock and it splits with a crack, THE SWARM scattering
he chases the halves left to right and rips them apart at lens on the run; ONE coin drops out and he snatches it
he whips a white lace handkerchief from under his wing case, wipes the coin in one pass right to left as he runs, then bites it and it bends double in his jaws

must_appear: THE SWARM streams after THE BALL from 0.0; at 1.9-3.3 THE BALL gets away and he sprints the whole frame after it; at 7.35 it splits on the rock; at 8.15 the halves rip open at lens and ONE gold coin falls out; at 8.95 he pulls the white lace handkerchief, wipes the coin on the run, then bites it and it bends double, his face to camera
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a still background, a still swarm, a hero climbing or riding a prop, a hero pushing on the spot, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, duplicate props, a held pose, a prop worked in place, slow motion, a broken ball before 7.35, speech after 7.35
